taskPacket.objective: src/plan/spec.mjs parses and validates a spec document without a model, classifying it structured or legacy and applying the traceability rules; faberun spec validate <file> [--strict-traceability] [--json] and faberun spec scaffold <path> expose it; src/plan/ becomes a layer in the AGENTS.md table.
instructions: Evidence: every spec under docs/campaigns/*/spec/ starts with a heading, none with front matter; the owner's PROPOSAL.md v1.1.0 (docs/campaigns/spec-format-and-planning-stages/spec/) and adversarial-planner's are the first structured ones. The format is described in skills/faberun/references/spec-format.md, written by the sibling node spec-format-reference in this phase; read it if it exists, else the PROPOSAL.md is the reference.

Change 1, src/plan/spec.mjs (new layer): `parseSpec(text)` returns {frontMatter|null, sections: Map<heading, body>, requirements: [{id, title, statement, proof}], ...}; `validateSpec(text, {cwd, strict})` returns {class: 'structured'|'legacy', ok, findings: [{rule, severity: 'advisory'|'blocking', message, line}]}. Rules on structured documents: mandatory sections Intent, Requirements, Non-goals (accept the pt-BR headings Intenção, Requisitos, Não-objetivos as aliases); requirement without a stable id (`### R<n>.`) or without a proof line; success-criteria table without a Baseline column; front matter target or baseline that does not resolve to a commit in cwd (bounded git through src/repo/worktree.mjs helpers, never a raw spawn; a target of the form owner/repo is checked against the origin remote name only). Findings are advisory (ok stays true) unless strict, when any finding makes ok false. A document without front matter is class legacy, ok true, one informative finding saying so. Nothing in the module imports harnesses or engine.

Change 2, src/cli/spec.mjs mirroring src/cli/contract.mjs: OPERATION_OPTIONS { validate: {'strict-traceability': boolean, json: boolean}, scaffold: {id: string} } (default-export the table like the other verb modules do, so src/cli/manual.mjs can read it); `spec validate <file>` prints `structured · ok` / `legacy · accepted` plus one line per finding, exit 1 when strict and not ok; `spec scaffold <path> [--id <id>]` writes an empty document in the format and refuses to overwrite. Dispatch `spec` in src/cli.mjs beside campaign/seat/skills/contract; add the usage lines in src/cli/brand.mjs renderUsage; add the verb to test/docs/command-surface.test.mjs (OPERATION_SOURCES and the by-name verb list) and to src/cli/manual.mjs's surface; run `npm run docs` and fill the authored prose of the two new manual sections.

Change 3: AGENTS.md layout table gains the row `| `plan/` | the out-of-session planner: spec format, repository facts, routing, sizing, freeze. Reads the target repository, never a provider. |` (edit only that table; the managed signal block at the bottom is the CLI's).

Docs: docs/CONCEPTS.md gains a short paragraph on specs as validated artefacts; the manual is regenerated by `npm run docs` (docs:check is in your verification).
